name: Artificial Intelligence & Data Science

longDesc: The Department of Artificial Intelligence & Data Science at D. Y. Patil College of Engineering, Akurdi Pune, was established to address the exponential demand for skilled computing engineers proficient in cutting-edge cognitive algorithms and large-scale data engineering. The department offers comprehensive industry-aligned curriculum supported by NVIDIA GPU computing labs, cloud environments, and industry mentorship programs.
